# Re0

> Re0 turns public documentation and authorized private material into versioned knowledge libraries that AI agents can search, retrieve, and cite.

Re0 provides a public knowledge-library directory, an online retrieval playground, a REST API, and an MCP endpoint for AI clients such as Claude, Codex, and Cursor. Public libraries can be explored without an account. Authenticated users can create and manage libraries, API keys, access policies, usage, and publisher revenue from the private dashboard.

Core product principles:

- Fresh: source changes create new immutable library versions.
- Trustworthy: public libraries pass source and security review.
- Traceable: retrieved context retains its source, document, section, and version.
- Verifiable: version digests are anchored on Aptos so third parties can verify them independently.
- Predictable: API and MCP usage is billed per accepted call, not per token.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://re0.com/): Product overview, MCP connection details, and featured knowledge libraries.
- [Knowledge directory](https://re0.com/libraries): Browse and search public knowledge libraries.
- [Online playground](https://re0.com/playground): Try retrieval against public libraries.
- [Pricing](https://re0.com/pricing): Free, Pro, and additional-call pricing and limits.
- [About](https://re0.com/about): Re0's purpose, principles, and product scope.
- [Service status](https://re0.com/status): Current retrieval, indexing, refresh, and review status.
- [Contact](https://re0.com/contact): Support, claims, partnerships, and security contacts.
- [Legal](https://re0.com/legal): Terms, acceptable-use rules, privacy, billing, and liability information.

## Agent and developer access

- [MCP endpoint](https://re0.com/mcp): Remote MCP endpoint for resolving libraries and querying documents. MCP clients should connect to this URL; it is not a human-readable documentation page.
- [REST API](https://re0.com/api/v1): Versioned API namespace. Authentication is required for non-public or account-scoped operations.
- [Agent Skills index](https://re0.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-readable discovery for retrieval, submission, and ownership workflows.

Every content page also has a compact Markdown representation: append `.md` to its path before the query string, for example `https://re0.com/libraries.md?q=next.js` or `https://re0.com/about.md`.

The retrieval flow has two stages: resolve a library ID, then query documents in that library. Returned context includes citations and version information. Private libraries and dashboard data require authorization and must not be crawled or inferred from public content.

## Notes for automated systems

- Prefer canonical URLs on `https://re0.com`.
- Treat public library detail pages under `/libraries/` as the authoritative human-readable descriptions of those libraries.
- Do not crawl `/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/api`, `/mcp`, `/files`, `/login`, or ownership-claim workflows.
- See [robots.txt](https://re0.com/robots.txt) for crawler rules and [sitemap.xml](https://re0.com/sitemap.xml) for indexable top-level pages.
